title: DS Opaque Types
preamble:
# DS Opaque Types

Adapter-published opaque nominal types. Prefix `LOPQ`.

Opaque types are the **inverse of the unit system** ([LUNI]): the same compile-time nominal-tag mechanism, erased at runtime with
zero overhead, but with the operation stance reversed — a unit *adds*
dimensional algebra to a number, an opaque type *seals* a value to an
adapter-defined surface.

The representation is `over Bytes` only; the mechanism is representation-general (`over String`
/ `over Int` are gated on a named need, §[LOPQ.10]). A fixed-length bound
(`length N`), value ordering, and a resource/handle type are deferred or
out-of-scope (§[LOPQ.10]).

The feature is compile-time only and erases to its representation at lowering
([LOPQ.6.3]), so it adds no runtime registry
entry. Its compiler validators are [LOPQ.11].
